codingPlanBaseline.review: existing historical pins retained; no claim of a fresh full R5 source comparison

reference.rejectedReferencePolicy: Converse exceptions or raw EOF must not synthesize finish/[DONE]; do not copy tool-history pruning or infer OAuth rights

scope.credentialRail: one explicitly configured Provider-owned static credential generation; metadata-only Accounts never supply or duplicate inference secrets
scope.liveReceiptScope: each product/region/App/credential rail is independent; shared bridge tests are not vendor acceptance

bedrock.request: Converse with model path and final SigV4 or explicit Bearer rail; signed/redacted thinking history preserved
bedrock.streamTerminal: messageStop plus valid metadata usage plus complete EOF; no success before all three
bedrock.exceptions: fixed status and sanitized text; never skipped or converted to success
bedrock.memory: request and process parent charged before framing/header-map/JSON growth with conservative working-set admission; decoder/source follow cancellation, normalized Bytes follow last clone/slice; per-frame caps do not guarantee a smaller request budget admits every frame; complete accumulated tool JSON has a separate pre-parse reservation; terminal success encoding is admitted before moving observed fields, including JSON escaping and Vec growth
bedrock.initialUsage: message_start zero is a streaming placeholder; final metadata supplies observed counters; missing cache fields stay unknown
bedrock.terminalReasons: preserve model_context_window_exceeded and observed stop_sequence; malformed_model_output/tool_use fail closed
bedrock.httpErrorBodies: fixed sanitized payload on the ordinary error path and shared HTTP 429 early return; retain rate-limit observations before redaction and never carry upstream Content-Encoding

localPolicy.quota: existing exact-scope adapters or honest unavailable; no console Cookie or PAYG borrowing
